messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — since the deploy we’re seeing 40–60ms tail latency spikes on kv-heavy long-context requests. Traces point to the eviction path, not network. Anyone else seeing this?
Aoife Gallagher: I noticed similar yesterday afternoon. Flamegraph from pprof shows a big chunk in evicter::choose_candidate and in pager::memmove during reinserts.
Samir Patel: Ran perf on a canary pod: FIFO reinserts hot path shows an O(n) scan when the hotset slides. Hot loop is doing a lot of pointer chasing and copying.
Kevin Li: Do we have a minimal repro? Can we flip to LRU or change policy per-pool to compare? @runtime-bot can you collect CPU/heap profiles for a few pods?
runtime-bot: Trace capture started for deployment=dedicated-12, collecting 45s CPU pprof + 30s heap. Files will be uploaded to /tmp/evict-traces-1712348000.tar.gz when done.
Maria Chen: Pasted top lines from the flame output: ```
38.2%  evict::handshake
22.1%  pager::scan_reinsert
11.4%  kv::reclaim_copy
7.8%   runtime::memcpy
6.5%   batching::commit_batch
```
Aoife Gallagher: Also seeing fragmentation increase after eviction bursts — reuse rate drops and we end up paging more frequently. Looks like reinserts are scattering entries across arenas.
Samir Patel: Quick experiment in staging: added sample-based probation to avoid full-list scans on reinserts (cheap guard for very long lists). Latency median unchanged but p95 improved ~18ms.
Kevin Li: Nice. We should also check batching heuristic — when we batch bigger token windows we retain larger KV chunks longer which increases pressure and makes eviction storms worse. Could be orthogonal but amplifying.
Maria Chen: Proposed plan: 1) run an A/B in staging with sample-probation enabled, 2) add an evicter backoff/throttle to smooth bursts, 3) emit new telemetry (reinsert_scan_len hist, evict_ops/s, fragment_pct).
Aoife Gallagher: I’ll open a small PR with the metrics and a debug endpoint to dump histograms: `runtimectl kv evict-stats --json` that prints: `{"scan_len_p50":.., "scan_len_p95":..}`.
Samir Patel: Also adding a small correctness fix — a CAS on reinsert head to avoid a rare interleaving where pager flush + reinsert loses a tombstone header. Not a latency cause but correctness risk.
Kevin Li: Can we gate the CAS behind a flag and run tests? If the sample-probation reduces p95 and passes tests, we can canary tonight.
Maria Chen: Yes — if staging looks good we’ll canary 5% at 23:00 UTC. Runtime-bot, schedule the canary and collect perf again after 10 minutes.
runtime-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 23:00 UTC, target=5%. Will collect CPU+heap profiles at +10m and +30m.
Samir Patel: One more note — profiler shows a secondary hotspot in batching::commit_batch that gets worse during eviction storms; likely victims waiting on kv locks inside batch commit. We should avoid holding per-request locks across reinsert paths.
Aoife Gallagher: Agreed. I’ll add lock profiling and a tracepoint for batch->evict handoff.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Action items: Samir -> PR for sample-probation + CAS, Aoife -> telemetry + tracepoints, Kevin -> coordinate canary and alerts, I’ll watch perf artifacts and cross-check reuse curves. I’ll paste artifacts here when runtime-bot uploads them. :thumbsup:
Kevin Li: :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: Uploaded artifacts: /tmp/evict-traces-1712348000.tar.gz (pprof + flame + histograms). Starting to triage now.
